_comment: Printed denominators for card sets, keyed by pokemontcg.io set id.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. card-index.json (the supplemental catalogue) stores
no denominator under any name -- its record keys are exactly
['d','g','i','id','n','nu','p','r','s','sc','si'] and no record contains a
'/' in 'nu'. So a card resolved from the local catalogue had no way to
produce '134/132', and the seeder never collected one: tools/seed_set_v2.py
selects id,name,releaseDate,total,series,ptcgoCode and writes neither total
nor printedTotal onto records.
WHY NOT DERIVED. The denominator must never come from the catalogue's
record count or its maximum card number. Mega Evolution holds 188 records
AND its highest number is 188, while the denominator printed on the cards
is 132. Both derivations give the wrong answer for exactly the card that
exposed this bug.
WHY ONLY ONE SET. This is the deliberately small, reviewed metadata update
for the affected set, so the Ivysaur export demonstrates 134/132 today.
Changing the seeder alone would not fix already-seeded records. A broad
catalogue backfill is a separate, separately-authorised piece of work, and
existing drafts are NOT migrated by this file.
HOW TO ADD A SET. Read printedTotal from the set object on
api.pokemontcg.io (GET /v2/cards/<setid>-<n> exposes it under .set, and
GET /v2/sets/<setid> returns it directly) and record the date it was
verified. Do not infer, round, or copy from a third-party listing.
An absent entry is correct behaviour: the formatter prints the bare
collector number rather than guessing a denominator.
